mapper.select: SELECT w.id AS warehouseId, w.enabled AS warehouseEnabled, s.id AS siteId, s.enabled AS siteEnabled FROM warehouses w LEFT JOIN sites s ON s.id = w.site_id AND s.tenant_id = w.tenant_id WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.id = #{warehouseId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, warehouse_id, request_id, transaction_no, spare_part_id, transaction_type, quantity, reference_type, reference_text, work_order_id, created_by, note, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM inventory_transactions WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND request_id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_order_parts ( work_order_id, spare_part_id, planned_quantity, issued_quantity, returned_quantity ) SELECT wo.id, sp.id, 0, 0, 0 FROM work_orders wo JOIN spare_parts sp ON sp.id = #{sparePartId} AND sp.tenant_id = wo.tenant_id WHERE wo.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND wo.id = #{workOrderId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = work_order_parts.id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM inventory_transactions WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
